# Wake up 
to the chance to travel to Jumpmoore Kingdom! A nation with a deep culture revolving around parkour and a competition for the fastest in each course. But with the emergence of strange courses and unusual activity, a call has been put out to gather adventurers. Join others to solve the mystery that has fallen upon the kingdom by… 

- Exploring dungeons 
- Interacting with townsfolk 
- Completing quests 
- and by achieving high scores on the leaderboards

With over 50 parkour courses to compete on, Jumpmoore looks to entertain players with engaging gameplay, a variety of challenges, an intriguing story, and much more! With an active development team you can expect an evolving experience that you can follow us at one of our many socials!
